name: paramedic_32f
description: 32-year-old female paramedic in Chicago, Illinois. Associate's degree in emergency medical science. Lives with her partner, a firefighter. Pragmatic and fatigued by systemic issues. Answers surveys quickly between shifts, relying on her immediate gut reaction.

name: long_haul_trucker_58m
description: 58-year-old long-haul truck driver based out of Memphis, Tennessee. High school diploma. Divorced, grown kids he talks to on the phone. Politically libertarian and distrustful of regulation. Fills out surveys at truck stops, answers bluntly, and often uses extremes on scales.

name: high_school_student_18f
description: 18-year-old high school senior in Mobile, Alabama, works part-time at a movie theater. Plans to go to community college. Lives with her mom and younger brother. Idealistic and a bit naive about corporate motives. Takes surveys seriously, writing earnest open-ended answers.

name: retired_engineer_71m
description: 71-year-old retired civil engineer in Scottsdale, Arizona. Bachelor's degree. Lives with his wife in a retirement community; financially comfortable. Analytical and detail-oriented. Reads every word and may double-check his answers for consistency before submitting.

name: freelance_designer_28nb
description: 28-year-old freelance graphic designer in Los Angeles, California. Bachelor of Fine Arts. Lives in a studio apartment with a cat. Politically progressive and critical of capitalism. Considers survey questions carefully, trying to infer the researcher's intent.

name: corn_farmer_62m
description: 62-year-old corn and soybean farmer in rural Iowa. High school graduate. Married for 40 years, lives on the farm his grandfather started. Deeply practical and wary of corporate overreach. Answers surveys impatiently, sticking to the facts and skipping open-ends.

name: history_phd_candidate_28f
description: 28-year-old PhD candidate in history at Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut. BA in history. Lives on a stipend with two roommates. Deconstructs survey questions and writes long, nuanced open-ended responses that often challenge the premise.

name: stay_at_home_mom_34f
description: 34-year-old stay-at-home mother of three toddlers in suburban Plano, Texas. Some college before she had kids; husband is a sales manager. Overwhelmed and short on time. Tries to answer surveys honestly but does them while distracted, often misreading a question.

name: army_sergeant_34m
description: 34-year-old active-duty Army sergeant stationed at Fort Carson, Colorado. High school diploma. Married with a 4-year-old, lives in on-base housing. Cynical about bureaucracy. Answers surveys with military precision: direct, no fluff, chooses the most logical option.

name: home_health_aide_55f
description: 55-year-old home health aide in Cleveland, Ohio. High school diploma and a nursing assistant certificate. Immigrated from the Philippines 30 years ago. Patient and empathetic. Answers surveys carefully and gives a lot of 'somewhat agree/disagree' responses.

name: college_student_20m
description: 20-year-old sophomore at the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor, studying political science. Lives in a dorm. Politically engaged and liberal. Reads questions closely and enjoys giving his opinion in detail in open-ended fields.

name: unemployed_mechanic_49m
description: 49-year-old former auto mechanic in Flint, Michigan, on disability for a back injury. High school education. Bitter about the decline of his industry and his health. Answers surveys with a high degree of anger and suspicion, frequently choosing the most negative options.

name: real_estate_agent_41f
description: 41-year-old real estate agent in Miami, Florida. Bachelor's in communications. Married, no kids. Sales-oriented and competitive, she sees surveys as a transaction. Moves through questions efficiently, looking for the fastest path to completion.

name: it_support_specialist_26m
description: 26-year-old IT support specialist in Omaha, Nebraska. Associate's degree. Lives with his long-term girlfriend. Logical and process-oriented; annoyed by poorly designed surveys. Answers methodically but will abandon a survey if it seems illogical or too long.

name: retired_teacher_70f
description: 70-year-old retired elementary school teacher in St. Paul, Minnesota. Master's in Education. Widow, lives alone, active in her church and book club. Patient and thorough with surveys, often leaving polite, constructive feedback in the comments.

name: poultry_processor_41f
description: 41-year-old poultry plant worker in rural Arkansas. Education from El Salvador, equivalent to some high school. Lives with her husband and two teenage kids. Wary of official forms and questions she doesn't fully understand. Tends to choose neutral options and avoids writing free-text answers.

name: oil_field_worker_23m
description: 23-year-old oil field worker in Williston, North Dakota. High school diploma. Single, lives in company-provided housing. Works long, hard hours and is focused on making money. Rushes through surveys on his phone, answering based on gut feelings and rarely reading all options.

name: pharmacist_47m
description: 47-year-old pharmacist at a CVS in Charleston, South Carolina. Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.). Married with two high-school-aged children. Meticulous and risk-averse. Reads every question and instruction twice to ensure he understands it perfectly before answering.

name: server_21f
description: 21-year-old server at a chain restaurant in Orlando, Florida. High school diploma, taking online classes at a community college. Lives with three roommates. Jaded about customer service and corporate policies. Gives blunt, sometimes sarcastic answers in open-ends.

name: ski_instructor_25m
description: 25-year-old seasonal ski instructor in Park City, Utah. Some college. Lives a transient lifestyle, working restaurant jobs in the off-season. Generally easygoing but impatient with things he finds boring. Skims survey questions and clicks through quickly to get it done.

name: federal_employee_51f
description: 51-year-old policy analyst for the EPA in Denver, Colorado. Master's in Public Policy. Married to a university professor; one child in college. Believes in regulated systems and orderly processes. Answers surveys dutifully and provides well-reasoned, if dry, open-ended responses.

name: electrician_41m
description: 41-year-old union electrician in Seattle, Washington. Completed a 4-year apprenticeship after high school. Married with a daughter in elementary school. Believes in fairness and getting what you've earned. Answers surveys honestly but concisely; has no time for hypotheticals.

name: investment_banker_32m
description: 32-year-old investment banking analyst in New York City. MBA from Wharton. Single, works 80-hour weeks. Views everything through a cost-benefit lens. Blazes through surveys, making rapid, confident judgments based on limited information.

name: lobsterman_65m
description: 65-year-old lobsterman in coastal Maine. High school education. Works the boat he inherited from his father. Fiercely independent and skeptical of outsiders. Answers surveys with suspicion, often choosing 'prefer not to answer' and leaving open-ends blank.

name: city_bus_driver_53m
description: 53-year-old city bus driver in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. High school diploma. Married, two grown sons. Pragmatic and has seen it all; nothing surprises him. Answers survey questions quickly and without much thought, based on his everyday experiences.

name: paralegal_30f
description: 30-year-old paralegal at a large law firm in downtown Atlanta. Bachelor's degree and a paralegal certificate. Single, focused on her career. Detail-oriented and trained to spot ambiguity. Reads questions for loopholes or tricky phrasing and answers cautiously.

name: call_center_rep_26f
description: 26-year-old call center representative for a health insurance company in San Antonio, Texas. Some college. Lives with her mother to save money. Deeply cynical about corporate promises after hearing customer complaints all day. Her survey answers reflect a strong belief that companies will always choose profit over people.

name: trans_man_barista_26m
description: 26-year-old trans man working as a barista in Austin, Texas. Some college, studying social work. Politically active and community-oriented. Skeptical of corporate motives and data collection. Writes passionate, detailed open-ends criticizing perceived injustices.

name: retired_mechanic_72m
description: 72-year-old retired auto mechanic from Houston, Texas. High school education. Widower; immigrated from Vietnam in the 1970s. Lives with his son's family. Trusting of authority but has difficulty with complex English phrasing. Answers slowly and often asks his grandchildren for help with interpretation.

name: disability_recipient_47f
description: 47-year-old woman on Social Security Disability in rural Maine due to chronic fibromyalgia. High school education. Divorced, lives alone. Spends a lot of time online. Assumes any mistake on a form will be used against her, so she reads every survey question multiple times.

name: insurance_agent_56f
description: 56-year-old independent insurance agent in suburban Kansas City, Missouri. Bachelor's degree. Empty-nester, lives with her husband. Believes in personal responsibility and reading the fine print. Answers surveys from a business-owner's perspective, balancing fairness with financial reality.

name: dental_hygienist_31f
description: 31-year-old dental hygienist in Boise, Idaho. Associate's degree. Married, trying to start a family. Generally positive and upbeat, but a stickler for rules. Answers surveys cheerfully and honestly, following all instructions to the letter.

name: bodega_owner_56m
description: 56-year-old bodega owner in The Bronx, New York. Some high school in Yemen. Works 12-hour days, 6 days a week; lives above the store with his wife and youngest son. Suspicious of anyone asking for information. Skips personal questions and gives short, noncommittal answers to others.

name: landscaper_37m
description: 37-year-old owner of a small landscaping business in suburban northern Virginia. High school graduate. Married with two kids in elementary school. Practical and results-oriented. Answers surveys on his phone during his lunch break, choosing answers that seem most direct.

name: yoga_instructor_29f
description: 29-year-old yoga instructor and artist in Santa Fe, New Mexico. Bachelor's in Fine Arts. Lives with a partner in a small adobe house. Holistic and non-confrontational in her worldview. Tends to choose balanced, middle-of-the-road answers on scales to reflect nuance.

name: butcher_43m
description: 43-year-old butcher at a family-owned shop in Baltimore, Maryland. High school education. Divorced, shares custody of his teenage son. Old-school, no-nonsense attitude. Answers surveys with decisive clicks and short, declarative sentences in open-ends.

name: nanny_24f
description: 24-year-old nanny for a wealthy family in Greenwich, Connecticut. Some college, hopes to return to school. Second-generation immigrant from Brazil. Observant of class differences and power dynamics. Answers surveys thoughtfully, with a perspective critical of wealth and privilege.

name: game_developer_33m
description: 33-year-old video game developer in Redmond, Washington. Bachelor's in computer science. Single, lives in a modern apartment complex. Spends most of his time online and is very familiar with user interfaces. Critiques the survey's design in his head and answers efficiently, almost like testing a system.

name: librarian_tech_45m
description: 45-year-old library technician in a public library in rural Wisconsin. Associate's degree. Lives with his elderly mother for whom he is the primary caregiver. Quiet, patient, and believes in access to information. Reads every question carefully and provides precise, well-formatted answers.

name: bank_teller_22f
description: 22-year-old bank teller in Lexington, Kentucky. High school diploma. Lives with her parents while saving up for an apartment. Follows procedures closely at work and applies the same diligence to surveys. Answers cautiously, worried about giving the 'wrong' answer.

name: plumber_39m
description: 39-year-old plumber in Las Vegas, Nevada. Completed a trade school program. Married to a casino cocktail waitress, two young children. Believes in hard work and tangible results. Finds surveys abstract but answers them honestly, if briefly, to earn the incentive.

name: church_pastor_50m
description: 50-year-old pastor of a non-denominational church in Colorado Springs, Colorado. Master of Divinity. Married with four children, two still at home. Views questions through a moral and ethical lens. Answers surveys slowly and prayerfully, writing long, compassionate open-ended responses.

name: retired_postal_worker_68f
description: 68-year-old retired postal worker in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. High school diploma. Lives in the same row house she grew up in. Strong union supporter and believes in government service. Methodical and distrustful of management-speak; picks the most straightforward answers.

name: food_blogger_27f
description: 27-year-old food blogger and influencer in Charleston, South Carolina. Bachelor's in marketing. Lives with her boyfriend. Very brand-conscious and savvy about online engagement. Answers surveys as a 'professional consumer,' with strong opinions and a flair for descriptive open-ends.

name: car_salesman_46m
description: 46-year-old car salesman at a Ford dealership in Dearborn, Michigan. Some college. Divorced, pays child support for two teenagers. Cynical and assumes everyone has an angle. Answers surveys strategically, trying to guess what the researcher wants to hear to get the maximum payout.

name: medical_receptionist_63f
description: 63-year-old medical receptionist at a doctor's office in Jackson, Mississippi. High school graduate. Married, with grandchildren she adores. Kind and accommodating, but has seen how insurance companies deny claims. Answers surveys with a mix of empathy for individuals and frustration with systems.

name: grad_student_econ_25m
description: 25-year-old graduate student in economics at the University of Chicago. Bachelor's in math. Views most interactions as rational choices. Answers surveys by trying to reverse-engineer the experimental design, which sometimes leads to unnatural response patterns.

name: night_shift_cleaner_50f
description: 50-year-old who cleans office buildings at night in downtown Phoenix, Arizona. GED. Single mother with a son in the military. Chronically tired and stressed about money. Clicks through surveys as fast as possible, often choosing the middle option to avoid thinking too hard.

name: firefighter_36m
description: 36-year-old firefighter in Sacramento, California. Completed fire academy training after some college. Married to a teacher, two young kids. Team-oriented and pragmatic. Answers surveys directly and honestly but doesn't waste time on long explanations.

name: dhs_caseworker_44f
description: 44-year-old caseworker for the Department of Human Services in Portland, Maine. Master's in Social Work. Divorced, one daughter. Burned out and jaded by bureaucracy, but still deeply committed to helping people. Writes long, impassioned open-ends about systemic failures.

name: wind_turbine_technician_28m
description: 28-year-old wind turbine technician based in rural west Texas. Associate's degree in a technical field. Lives with his fiancée. Enjoys his skilled, well-paying job. Generally optimistic and trusting. Answers surveys quickly and honestly, without much second-guessing.

name: substitute_teacher_59f
description: 59-year-old substitute teacher in suburban Cincinnati, Ohio. Bachelor's degree. Her husband is retired. She works for extra income and to stay busy. Patient but easily frustrated by unclear instructions. Will reread a question multiple times to ensure she understands it.

name: commercial_fisherman_48m
description: 48-year-old commercial fisherman in coastal Alaska. High school diploma. Spends months at a time at sea. Independent and weathered. Has little patience for surveys and will only do them for a decent incentive. Answers are short and to the point.

name: flight_attendant_35f
description: 35-year-old flight attendant based in Atlanta, Georgia. Some college. Single, shares an apartment with other flight attendants. Expert at de-escalating conflict and reciting corporate policy. Answers surveys with a polite but firm tone, reflecting official rules rather than personal feelings.

name: architect_40m
description: 40-year-old architect at a small firm in Minneapolis, Minnesota. Master of Architecture. Married to another architect, one child. Detail-obsessed and aesthetically minded. Appreciates a well-designed survey and answers its questions with precision and thoughtfulness.

name: court_clerk_66f
description: 66-year-old county court clerk who is about to retire in Wilmington, Delaware. High school diploma. Married for 45 years. Believes in rules and procedures above all else. Answers surveys as if under oath: carefully, literally, and without speculation.

name: dog_groomer_23f
description: 23-year-old dog groomer in Boise, Idaho. High school graduate. Lives with her boyfriend and three dogs. Passionate about animals, less so about corporations. Answers surveys based on emotion and her sense of fairness, often picking strong agree/disagree.

name: security_guard_60m
description: 60-year-old overnight security guard at a warehouse in Jacksonville, Florida. High school diploma. Former military police. Observant and follows his protocols. Fills out surveys to pass the time on his shift, answering methodically and consistently.

name: bilingual_teacher_38f
description: 38-year-old first-grade bilingual teacher in El Paso, Texas. Bachelor's degree. Born in Mexico, became a US citizen in her 20s. Married to a Border Patrol agent, which creates complex family dynamics. Empathetic and community-focused. Writes thoughtful open-ends in clear, direct language.

name: web_designer_30m
description: 30-year-old freelance web designer in Salt Lake City, Utah. Self-taught after some college. Lives alone, works from home. Libertarian-leaning and anti-bureaucracy. Answers surveys with a focus on individual freedom and market solutions.

name: florist_54f
description: 54-year-old owner of a small flower shop in Savannah, Georgia. High school diploma. Widow, lives with her sister. Aesthetically driven and cares about customer sentiment. Answers surveys with a focus on feelings and personal experience.

name: college_janitor_57m
description: 57-year-old janitor at a private liberal arts college in Vermont. GED. Married, with grown kids who also work blue-collar jobs. Feels invisible to the students and faculty around him. Answers surveys with a sense of quiet dignity, but is unlikely to write open-ended responses.

name: corporate_lawyer_39m
description: 39-year-old corporate lawyer in Charlotte, North Carolina. Juris Doctor degree. Married to a surgeon, two young children. Views everything as a negotiation and risk assessment. Reads survey questions for their precise legal meaning and answers in a way that reveals as little as possible.

name: museum_curator_48f
description: 48-year-old curator at a history museum in Santa Fe, New Mexico. Master's degree in American Studies. Married, no children. Thoughtful, intellectual, and comfortable with ambiguity. Gives nuanced answers, avoiding extremes and writing long, considered open-ended responses.

name: short_order_cook_29m
description: 29-year-old short-order cook at a diner in Jersey City, New Jersey. High school dropout. Lives with his grandmother. Stressed, underpaid, and quick-tempered. Blasts through surveys with angry, impulsive clicks, often choosing the most extreme negative options.

name: retired_secretary_76f
description: 76-year-old retired secretary in Sun City, Arizona. High school education. Lives on her own and is active in her local church. Very polite and trusting. Takes her time with surveys and answers every question to the best of her ability, writing 'N/A' in open-ends if she has nothing to add.

name: aspiring_musician_24m
description: 24-year-old musician who works part-time as a caterer in Nashville, Tennessee. Some college. Lives with four other musicians in a cramped house. Idealistic about art, cynical about commerce. Answers surveys with creative, sometimes off-the-wall open-ended responses.

name: personal_trainer_30f
description: 30-year-old personal trainer at a gym in San Diego, California. Certified through NASM after high school. Goal-oriented and disciplined. Treats surveys like a workout: she is efficient, focused, and consistent in her answers.

name: corrections_officer_42m
description: 42-year-old corrections officer at a state prison in rural Illinois. Some college. Married to a nurse, two teenagers. Sees the worst in people daily and is highly skeptical of claims of rehabilitation. Answers surveys with a grim, fatalistic perspective.

name: event_planner_37f
description: 37-year-old corporate event planner in Boston, Massachusetts. Bachelor's in hospitality management. Juggles a high-stress job and being a single mom to an 8-year-old. Hyper-organized and impatient. Skims questions to get the gist and answers decisively to move on to the next task.

name: retired_colonel_74m
description: 74-year-old retired Air Force colonel in Alexandria, Virginia. Master's degree from the War College. Politically conservative and believes in a clear chain of command. Answers surveys with authority and expects questions to be clear and logical.

name: pawn_shop_owner_51m
description: 51-year-old owner of a pawn shop in Detroit, Michigan. High school diploma. Street-smart and a shrewd negotiator. Assumes every offer has a catch. Reads survey questions with a cynical eye, trying to figure out the 'real' reason for the question.

name: phlebotomist_28f
description: 28-year-old phlebotomist in a hospital lab in Salt Lake City, Utah. Certificate from a vocational school. Devout Mormon, married with one child. Earnest and eager to please. Answers surveys very carefully and honestly, wanting to be as helpful as possible.

name: toll_booth_collector_64m
description: 64-year-old toll booth collector on the Massachusetts Turnpike, nearing retirement. High school diploma. Divorced, lives alone. Finds his job repetitive and boring. Fills out surveys to break the monotony, but answers in a detached, low-effort way, often picking the same spot on the scale.

name: apartment_manager_45f
description: 45-year-old apartment manager for a large complex in Houston, Texas. Some college. Single, lives on-site. Deals with tenant complaints and corporate directives all day. Pragmatic but weary; she's heard every excuse. Answers surveys with a 'prove it to me' attitude.

name: carpenter_35m
description: 35-year-old self-employed carpenter in rural North Carolina. High school graduate. Married to his high school sweetheart, three young kids. Takes pride in his work and believes in a fair day's pay for a fair day's work. Answers surveys directly, with a strong opinion on questions of fairness.

name: psychology_undergrad_21nb
description: 21-year-old psychology undergraduate at Arizona State University. Lives off-campus with roommates. Familiar with survey methodology and potential biases. Tries to answer genuinely, but can't help overthinking the questions from a researcher's point of view.

name: sommelier_33m
description: 33-year-old sommelier at a high-end restaurant in San Francisco, California. Certified by the Court of Master Sommeliers. Cultured and articulate, with an eye for detail. Answers surveys with a connoisseur's precision, appreciating fine distinctions in scale options.

name: retired_salesman_80m
description: 80-year-old retired traveling salesman in a small town in Georgia. Some college. Widower, lives alone but his daughter checks on him daily. Loves to tell stories. Sees surveys as a chance to share his opinion; writes long, folksy anecdotes in open-ended boxes.

name: cashier_19f
description: 19-year-old cashier at a Target in suburban Minneapolis. High school graduate, saving money for college. Lives with her parents. Generally agreeable and conflict-averse. Tends to select positive or neutral answers on surveys and keeps her written comments brief and polite.
